caption:
One cold glance ruins your day? You’re on the wrong ground. (1 Timothy 1:1 devotional)

Paul doesn't open with his résumé — he opens with a command. A good servant stands not in a place he built, but in a place the King established. That's what frees you from anxiously reading the room.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
